entries.final_answer: Operator rulings 2026-11-20 (binding): (1) strict accept gate reads the implementer from status/review_roles; (2) the API claim records agent=--actor through the shared claim-sidecar builder, also API transition --to claimed and agent status emit --to claimed; (3) a canceled WP with no claim history needs no implementer, never fabricated; (4) the repair hint names a command that works from that state, derived from the state machine, else no hint, and a test runs it; (5) fold #5818: accept-mission uses the provenance-aware acceptable-ending predicate; (6) fold #7644: API --to planned releases the claim slots; (7) #7752 only if a shared canceled helper falls out (it does not); (8) #5782 sequenced after.
